sv.title: Nattsäsong är årets skönlitterära bok
sv.summary: Sveriges mest prestigefulla litteraturpris, Augustpriset, delades ut under måndagskvällen. Vinnarna i de tre kategorierna, årets skönlitterära bok, årets fackbok och årets barn- och ungdomsbok, tar alla hem 100.000 kronor vardera.

en.title: Nattsäsong is the year's best fiction book
en.summary: Sweden's most prestigious literary prize, the August Prize, was awarded on Monday evening. The winners in the three categories, the year's fiction book, the year's non-fiction book and the year's children's and young adult book, each take home SEK 100,000.
